title: An entity filter opens a searchable panel with a list and Clear selection
permissions_required: Any signed-in user with access to the Work Orders page (the spec defines no role-based differences - OQ-4).
preconditions:
1. You are signed in on a desktop browser.

1. Click the entity filter chip (for example Customer).

expected:
